# Geology Science

> A comprehensive educational resource for understanding Earth's structure, rocks, minerals, and the dynamic geological processes that shape our planet.

Geology Science provides in-depth guides and references covering all major branches of geology, from plate tectonics and structural geology to petrology, volcanology, and paleontology. The site serves students and enthusiasts seeking to understand Earth science fundamentals, rock and mineral classification, and geological phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Plate Tectonics
- Petrology
- Volcanology
- Paleontology
- Structural Geology
- Physical Geology
- Igneous Rocks
- Sedimentary Rocks
- Metamorphic Rocks
- Mineralogy
- Rock Formation
- Earth Structure
- Geologic Time Scale
- Mineral Identification
- Engineering Geology

## Foundational Geology

- [Geology Science: Study of Earth Science, Rocks and Minerals](https://geologyscience.com): Homepage introducing geology, earth science, rocks, minerals, and volcanic processes
- [Branches of Geology – Major Fields of Earth Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches): Overview of major geology disciplines including structural, mineralogy, engineering geology
- [Structure of the Earth: Layers, Composition, and Internal Dynamics](https://geologyscience.com/geology/structure-of-earth): Guide to Earth's crust, mantle, core, heat, pressure, and internal convection

## Plate Tectonics & Crustal Dynamics

- [Plate Tectonics – Definition, Theory, Plate Boundaries, and Hotspots](https://geologyscience.com/geology/plate-tectonics): Comprehensive guide to plate tectonics theory, boundaries, continental drift, and hotspots
- [Structural Geology Explained | Faults, Folds & Crustal Deformation](https://geologyscience.com/structural-geology): Guide to faults, folds, stress, strain, and tectonic forces shaping Earth's crust
- [Physical Geology | Earth's Surface Processes & Formation](https://geologyscience.com/physical-geology): Guide to Earth's materials, plate tectonics, volcanoes, erosion, and landscape evolution

## Rocks & Rock Formation

- [What Is Rock? Types of Rocks, Their Formation, and Complete Geological Classification](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2): Guide to rock types, formation, and classification of igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic rocks
- [Igneous Rocks | Types, Classification, Properties, Formation](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/igneous-rocks): Comprehensive guide to igneous rocks covering types, classification, properties, and formation
- [Sedimentary Rocks | Types, Classification, Properties, Formation](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/sedimentary-rocks): Guide to sedimentary rocks explaining accumulation, compaction, cementation, and classification
- [Metamorphic Rocks | Formation, Types, Textures & Metamorphism](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/metamorphic-rock): Guide to metamorphic rocks formed by heat, pressure, and tectonic processes in Earth's crust
- [Petrology: The Science of Rocks, Their Origin and Transformation](https://geologyscience.com/petrology): Overview of petrology explaining igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rock formation

## Minerals & Gemstones

- [Mineral Identification: Properties, Formation & Uses](https://geologyscience.com/minerals): Guide to minerals covering formation, composition, properties, classification, and industrial uses
- [Physical Properties of Minerals - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/mineralogy/physical-properties-of-minerals): Reference guide to physical properties of minerals for identification and classification
- [Optical Properties of Minerals - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/mineralogy/optical-properties-of-minerals): Technical reference on optical properties, microscopy, birefringence, and refractive index
- [Gemstones: Properties, Types, Formation & Identification Guide](https://geologyscience.com/gemstones): Beginner-friendly guide to gemstones including properties, types, formation, and identification

## Volcanology & Earth Dynamics

- [Volcanology: Volcano Types, Eruptions & Hazards](https://geologyscience.com/volcanology): Overview of volcanology covering volcano formation, eruption types, and hazards

## Paleontology & Earth History

- [Paleontology | Fossils, Evolution, Ancient Life & Earth's Deep History](https://geologyscience.com/paleontology): Guide to paleontology, fossils, evolution, mass extinctions, and Earth's ancient life
- [Geologic Time Scale : Divisions, Periods and Eons - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/paleontology/geologic-time-scale): Reference on geologic time scale divisions, eons, eras, periods, and dating methods

## Optional

- [Gallery | Geological Wonders, List of Geological Phenomena](https://geologyscience.com/gallery): Visual collection of geological formations, mountains, canyons, crystals, and rock formations
- [Videos | Geology, Wonders, Disasters &... - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/videos): Video library featuring educational geology content on branches, rocks, minerals, and earth
